description: A shell script containing tests for Git ref namespace fetch/push functionality, including setup, push, pull, clone, and ref hiding tests.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, with setup and execution commands.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Sets up timing or environment for tests.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or tests Git configuration options.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in output logs.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures a command fails as expected.
